headline: Motional Shifts to AI-First Architecture for L4 Autonomous Driving, Enabling "Large Driving Models".

headline: US Stock Market Slips as Tech Earnings Disappoint and AI Spending Returns Weighed Against Growth, Fueled by Rising Oil Prices.
